newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one - Dec 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one - Dec 20.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Friday:
- As the siege on the Japanese Ambassador's residence in Lima, Peru, went into its third night, diplomats shuttled between Peruvian officials and rebel leaders trying to free about 400 hostages.
- Peru received but did not act on several warnings in the last year that guerrilla groups were planning raids.
- The New Jersey State Legislature approved a bill to set broad curriculum standards and commit the state to help each district spend what it takes to meet those standards.
- New York City's crime rate has plunged for the third straight year.

- The Justice Department has issued subpoenas to the White House and President Clinton's legal defence fund seeking records concerning activities of many of the Democrats' most important fund raisers and supporters.
